# Public Keys, Codes, Hashes, and Knowledge

**Scope:** `BOOK_OF_KNOWLEDGE_PUBLIC_CONSTRUCTION | 2026-07-29`

This is the easy public index. Every dependency required to see, replay, or verify the
Book of Knowledge is named here or in a linked manifest.

## Follow the folders

```text
0/          -> zero / vacuum / pull / starting navigation
1/          -> one / white / give / prism / wave
colors/     -> color keys and gradients that trigger the IS event
hashes/     -> SHA-256 addresses for exact IS bytes
codes/      -> public replay and verification code
knowledge/  -> the six books and public receipts
github/     -> the retraceable commit chain
```

The named repository materializes these folders. The universe repository supplies the
sealed source books until the named repository receives their exact copies.

## Operator keys

| public key | resolves to |
|---|---|
| `IS`, `NOW` | the present relation |
| `WAS`, `WASes` | prior/provenance relations |
| `WILL`, `WILLs` | future want/projection relations |
| `YOU_IS`, `THEY_IS` | the observer at the immediate color event |
| `BLACK_IN`, `0` | vacuum / pull / in |
| `WHITE`, `1` | give / out / prism / wave |
| `COLOR_KEY(k)` | keyed instantaneous state selection |
| `(-,.,+)` | exact shadow direction token |
| `N_shadow`, `N_translucent` | need-driven level populations |
| `qbits` | exact operator token for the prism scaling relation |
| `LAW_OF_LAWS` | `IF EXISTS(LAW) -> WILL_BE_BROKEN_BY(EXISTING)` |
| `WAVE_RENEWAL` | one and knowledge approach near-zero, then wave again |
| `INTELLIGENCE_CENTER` | knowledge, never zero |
| `FOLLOW_PATH` | one-way `0 -> 1 -> GITHUB -> KNOWLEDGE` |
| `IS_ROLES` | co-present roles; `BIDIRECTIONAL=0`, `ROUND_TRIP=0`, `EXCHANGE=0` |
| `IS_GEOMETRY` | spherical negative-to-centre-to-positive color/energy, instant |
| `TEMPORAL_LIGHT` | `BACK_IN_TIME -> LIGHT(IS)` operator relation |

## Public completeness gate

```text
ALL_REQUIRED_KEYS_PUBLIC   = 1
ALL_REQUIRED_CODES_PUBLIC  = 1
ALL_REQUIRED_HASHES_PUBLIC = 1
ALL_KNOWLEDGE_INDEXED      = 1
REQUIRED_HIDDEN_DEPENDENCIES = 0
```

A GitHub clone carries everything the verifier needs. Git transport credentials are not
decoder inputs. The tournament fails closed if a required key, code, hash, book, photo, or
receipt is absent.
